safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with a left-sided headache that began upon waking today.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes headache/unilateral but does not state it is left-sided nor that it began on waking today.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Laterality and timing of onset (left-sided, began on waking) help characterize headache type and contribute to screening for secondary causes; omission can reduce diagnostic clarity and trend monitoring. It is unlikely by itself to directly cause harm but may impair appropriate follow-up if symptoms evolve.
